## How Does the Royal Collection Work? (Royal Match Cards)

The Royal Collection is an event that runs over 62 days where you collect cards to complete sets to unlock rewards.

The ultimate goal is to collect each of the 135 available cards to complete all 15 sets to win a Grand Prize of 10,000 Gold Coins, Boosters, and an exclusive profile badge. [...] Here are the rewards for the Grand Royal Collection:

 15,000 free coins
 15 Rockets, 15 TNTs, and 15 Light Balls

## Completing the Grand Royal Collection (Can You Still Share Cards?)

Here is a screenshot of my completed Grand Royal Collection:

Once you’ve completed the Grand Royal Collection, you will no longer receive Card Packs as rewards.

Instead, you’ll earn normal prizes, like Boosters, for example.

This time, your card collection doesn’t reset. [...] 20. I too have completed the grand royal collection – basically collecting the entire set 2X. You do get to keep whatever spare cards you have and can share them, but you will no longer have new card packs as rewards. I found that there will be 1 card that you are missing – likely a gold one that can’t be traded – and the only way you will get it is by working toward a red and pack. results.title: All about Collections in Royal Match
results.content:
Collections are unlocked at level 41. They are groups of themed cards that are only available for a limited time. You'll earn these cards in packs as rewards for completing events, tournaments, and opening area chests. [...] If you are able to collect every card in a Collection by the end of the event, you will receive the Collection’s Grand Prize, which not only contains multiple power-ups, boosters, and other rewards, but you'll also receive a special Badge that can be displayed next to your username. [...] If you complete a Collection a second time before the event ends, you'll receive an even more prestigious Badge and additional rewards on top of what you received before. Make sure to finish Collections as soon as possible to earn these badges and extras.
